title: Vickers Wellington Z8799
memorial_details: Three stepped base surmounted by square metal column. Metal plaque with dedication in white lettering on the front face of the column
inscription: TO THE MEMORY OF/ (Names)/ KILLED WHEN/ A WELLINGTON BOMBER/ CRASHED ON THESE MOORS/ ON NOV. 12TH 1943./ ERECTED BY THE/ ROTARY CLUB OF HORWICH/ JUNE 1955/ Small Brass plaque: IN LOVING MEMORY OF/ FLT. SGT. JOE TIMPERON/ ON THIS 60TH ANNIVERSARY/ OF THEIR CRASH 16/11/2003/ PROUDLY REMEMBERED/ BY HIS SISTER MARY, SISTER-IN-LAW SHIRLEY/ AND FAMILY MEMBERS IN SOUTH AUSTRALIA
